install.name: Node.js 22
install.run: mkdir -p .revolte/runtime && architecture=$(uname -m) && case "$architecture" in x86_64) architecture=x64 ;; aarch64) architecture=arm64 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac && curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2-linux-$architecture.tar.xz | tar -xJ --strip-components=1 -C .revolte/runtime
